domain_restrictions: n is a positive natural number (so n is at least 1)
division by n is defined (follows from n being positive)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all positive natural numbers n: 0 is less than or equal to 0, and 0 is strictly less than 1 divided by n.

variables.name: n
variables.role: index for the reciprocal 1/n and quantification variable

witness_dependencies: no existential witnesses are introduced; the statement is purely universal

statement_nl: For every positive natural number n, one has 0 <= 0 and 0 < 1/n.
